summary.zh: 网站入口页：快速了解学习智能体能为你做什么，并进入各模块。
summary.en: The landing page: see what the learning agent can do and enter each module.

zh: 点击任一模块卡片进入
en: Click any module card to enter

summary.zh: 与 AI 老师对话学习：针对你的教材提问、追问、获得讲解与练习，学习表现会进入评价。
summary.en: Learn by talking with the AI tutor: ask about your textbooks, follow up, get explanations and practice; real performance feeds the learner model.

zh: 选择或在当前学习区提问
回顾本会话的学习记录
en: Pick or stay in a workspace and ask
Keep following up until it clicks

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录；建议先在学习区绑定教材。
prerequisites.en: Login required; binding textbooks in a workspace is recommended.

summary.zh: 把教材变成一节课：生成课件与讲稿，在课程介绍页查看安排，可编辑组件与讲稿，再进入课堂播放器上课、插问、做随堂题并导出。
summary.en: Turn textbooks into a lesson: generate slides and narration, review the course overview, edit blocks and scripts, then teach, ask questions, run quizzes and export in the classroom player.

zh: 进入备课上课并点击备课，填写主题、时长与偏好
等待课件生成，在课程介绍页查看时长、目标与逐页安排
需要时进入编辑：手动改组件文字或让 AI 定向优化单个组件、讲稿、主题与配图
点击开始上课：先选页预览，再全屏开课并按需配音
课后查看讲稿、课堂记录或导出
en: Open Courses and click prepare; fill topic, duration and preferences
Wait for generation and review duration, objectives and page plan on the course overview
Optionally edit: tweak block text manually or let AI refine a single block, script, theme or image
Click start teaching: pick a page to preview, then go fullscreen and use voice as needed
Review the script, classroom records or export after class

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录且课堂功能已开启。
prerequisites.en: Login required and the classroom feature must be enabled.

summary.zh: 沉淀学习笔记：Markdown 编辑、双链、标签、版本历史与复习计划。
summary.en: Accumulate study notes: Markdown editing, backlinks, tags, revision history and review scheduling.

summary.zh: 查看学习活动概览：近期学习日、作答与任务完成情况，按学习区分组。
summary.en: See your learning activity overview: recent learning days, answers and completed tasks grouped by workspace.

zh: 选择学习区与时间范围

summary.zh: 浏览教材知识图谱：概念、先修关系与内容定位，可跳转辅导或测评。
summary.en: Browse the textbook knowledge map: concepts, prerequisite chains and content locators, with handoffs to tutoring or assessment.

zh: 点击概念查看详情与先修路径
en: Click a concept for details and prerequisites

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录；需已解析的教材。

summary.zh: 管理学习目标与每天的任务安排：创建目标、生成周计划、调整任务并启动辅导。
summary.en: Manage learning goals and daily tasks: create goals, generate weekly plans, adjust tasks and launch tutoring.

zh: 创建学习目标并设定可用时间
开始某项任务进入辅导
en: Create a goal and set available time

summary.zh: 进行结构化测评与练习：按概念出题、作答判分、查看报告与错题记录。
summary.en: Take structured assessments and practice: question selection by concept, graded answers, reports and the error notebook.

zh: 选择概念范围开始测评

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录；建议在学习区中选定教材范围。
prerequisites.en: Login required; a textbook scope in a workspace is recommended.

summary.zh: 查看 AI 记住了什么：学习档案、概念状态、证据时间线与跨会话记忆，可发起证据复核。
summary.en: See what the AI remembers: learning archive, concept states, the evidence timeline and cross-session memory; request evidence reviews.

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录且有学习记录。

summary.zh: 管理个人文件：上传、文件夹整理、绑定到学习区供辅导和备课使用。
summary.en: Manage personal files: upload, organize into folders, and bind them to workspaces for tutoring and lessons.

zh: 上传文件或新建文件夹
在工作区设置中绑定资料

summary.zh: 上传与管理教材：解析进度、卷册章节、图谱质量，并可重建。
summary.en: Upload and manage textbooks: parsing progress, volumes and chapters, graph quality and rebuilds.

zh: 查看卷册章节与图谱状态
en: Review volumes, chapters and graph status

summary.zh: 找回被归档的内容：按类型浏览、恢复到目标学习区；彻底清除在确认界面完成。
summary.en: Recover archived items: browse by type and restore into a target workspace; permanent purge happens on its own confirm page.

en: Choose a restore target and restore

summary.zh: 从右上角我的账户查看账户信息，编辑姓名、学校、关注学科与上传裁剪头像；学段在设置中调整。
summary.en: View account information and edit your name, school and subjects, and upload a cropped avatar from My account. Adjust stage in Settings.

zh: 查看账户信息或编辑个人资料
en: Open My account in the top bar
Review account information or edit personal details

prerequisites.en: Sign in to view and edit.

summary.zh: 右上角头像左侧的设置页面：通用、学习与回答、语音与课堂、助手、资料处理、账户与数据、关于。
summary.en: Settings to the left of the account avatar: general, learning and answers, voice and classroom, assistant, document processing, account and data, and about.

zh: 点击右上角头像左侧设置
调整偏好或保存账户配置
en: Open Settings next to the account avatar
Adjust preferences or save account configuration

prerequisites.zh: 本地偏好无需登录；账户偏好需要登录。
prerequisites.en: Browser preferences work for guests; account preferences require sign-in.

summary.zh: 查看从学习互动派生的学术画像、交互特点与学习激励。
summary.en: View your academic profile, interaction patterns and learning motivation.

zh: 从右上角我的账户进入学习画像
查看学习激励与连续学习天数
en: Open Learning Profile from My account

summary.zh: 查看 AI 教学效果评价：教学诊断、策略统计与改进提案；批准或应用由你确认。
summary.en: Review AI teaching-effectiveness: diagnostics, strategy stats and improvement proposals; approvals are yours to confirm.

zh: 查看教学诊断与策略统计
阅读提案并决定是否批准/应用
en: Read proposals and decide whether to approve/apply

prerequisites.zh: 需要登录且有教学交互记录。
prerequisites.en: Login required with teaching interaction records.

summary.zh: 网站使用说明：各功能的作用、步骤与注意事项。
summary.en: Usage documentation: what each feature does, its steps and caveats.

en: Find the feature section in the table of contents

summary.zh: 管理员后台：账号、孤儿数据清理、解析服务与教材策略等系统配置。
summary.en: Admin console: accounts, orphan-data cleanup, parsing services and textbook policies.

zh: 按卡片打开对应管理功能

summary.zh: 登录已有账号，继续你的学习记录与设置。
summary.en: Sign in to an existing account to continue your records and settings.

summary.zh: 创建新账号，开始使用全部学习功能。
summary.en: Create a new account to start using all learning features.

en: Fill in the form to register
